evidence.title: Remote Control
evidence.locator: Requirements; actions; notifications; multiple machines; disconnects
evidence.finding: Browser dashboard at antigravity.google.com drives desktop sessions and CLI instances: view active conversations, start new agent tasks, review implementation plans and inspect artifacts; tool confirmations and clarifying questions can be answered from the terminal or the remote UI; settings cannot be changed from the web and no agent stop action is described. No native mobile app; the web app can be installed on a home screen for push notifications. CLI interactive mode (/remote-control, --remote-control) and a headless daemon (agy remote-control start) registered as a systemd user service (Linux), LaunchAgent (macOS) or Scheduled Task (Windows). Daemon logs: journalctl on Linux, ~/Library/Logs/antigravity-cli-daemon.log on macOS, cli-*.log under %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity-cli\log on Windows. Background tasks keep running while the host stays online.
